mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_VIEW_HISTORY (member_id, sku, viewed_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sku}, #{viewedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = VALUES(viewed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT h.sku, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, (p.stock_qty <= 0) AS soldOut, h.viewed_at AS viewedAt FROM PRODUCT_VIEW_HISTORY h JOIN PRODUCTS p ON h.sku = p.sku WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.viewed_at DESC, h.sku ASC LIMIT #{limit}
